headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 28, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge. García Jr. collected 3 hits, including 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. In other action, the Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, while the Houston Astros took down the Detroit Tigers 7-5.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Roman Anthony, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list for the Boston Red Sox. The Texas Rangers have also placed Wyatt Langford on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other teams have made similar moves, with the Cincinnati Reds placing Blake Dunn on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 27, and the Chicago Cubs placing Hoby Milner on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 26.

The San Francisco Giants made a roster move ahead of the deadline, trading 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners in exchange for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays also made a trade, sending RHP Hayden Juenger to the Athletics in exchange for C Owen Carapellotti. Additionally, the Chicago Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates. Ryan O'Hearn led the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers edged out the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, winning 3-2. Nathan Lukes led the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in a closely contested game. Isaac Paredes led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, while Jack Flaherty pitched 5 strong innings for the Astros, striking out 9 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Roman Anthony Shifts to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox left fielder Roman Anthony has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list, marking a significant change in his status.

top_news.title: **Giants Make Roster Move Ahead of Deadline**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants have made a trade, sending 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners in exchange for cash.
